chunks: Al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
ʿUmrah is obligatory like hajj. So when one performs tamattuʿ, one has fulfilled the obligatory ʿumrah.

key_terms.أَدَّى: performed or discharged a religious duty
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةُ: the lesser pilgrimage, here described as a binding obligation
key_terms.الْمُتْعَةَ: tamattuʿ, the pilgrimage form in which ʿumrah is performed before hajj

ai.seo_question: Does performing tamattuʿ count as fulfilling the obligatory ʿumrah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that ʿumrah is obligatory in the same way as hajj. It also explains that performing tamattuʿ fulfills the required obligatory ʿumrah.
